text: Presentation from Tamara Anson-Cartwright, Program Manager, Heritage Planning in recognition of Kathryn Anderson, Heritage Planner, for her thirty years of dedicated public service (1989-2020) to the City of Toronto and for her outstanding contribution as an architectural historian to the conservation of heritage in Canada.
The Toronto Preservation Board received the report (August 9, 2020) from the Senior Manager, Heritage Planning, Urban Design, City Planning, for information.
